data.body:
Fixes bug B-regression-collect-reloads-cfg: bug fixed --landed <test-only-commit> crashes with InvalidValue worktree.base_ref=--local when the landing commit's committed .ddflow/config.toml carries base_ref=--local. regression_collect.tree_provides calls run_command_gate(probe, root) without cfg, so runner reloads Config.load(root) from the scratch tree (B20cfd41344's fix was applied to mutation.py:331 but missed this probe path, and regression.py:67 has the same hole).

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B-regression-collect-reloads-cfg --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B-regression-collect-reloads-cfg --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B-regression-collect-reloads-cfg: --landed of a test-only fix crashes: regression_collect reloads the scratch...

evidence.note: CONFIRMED by reproduction. Claim: regression_collect.tree_provides calls run_command_gate(probe, root) without cfg, so the runner does Config.load(cwd) against the probed/scratch tree; a historical committed worktree.base_ref=--local (present at 4fadc519c/7072a3c00) then raises InvalidValue. Reproduced: `ddflow --agent bgr bug fixed Bb9da8bb300 --landed 7072a3c00 --regression-test tests/test_complete_validates_before_approval.py::test_precheck_and_bug_fixed_refuse_the_same_half_node_id` -> InvalidValue: invalid worktree.base_ref='--local', full traceback shows runner.run_command_gate:309 Config.load(cwd) with cwd=scratch tree. Refutation test: apply cfg threading and re-run tree_provides on a tree whose .ddflow/config.toml has base_ref=--local; if it no longer raises, the cfg-drop is the mechanism.

r-bounded-everything, r-ddflow-self-assessment (this bug was found closing a duplicate; filed before fixing), r-everything-configurable. The fix reuses the caller's Config (threaded), no new knob. B20cfd41344 fixed the run path; this closes the probe path consistently.

Committed 566089c95: tree_provides gains a * cfg kwarg passed to run_command_gate; both callers (regression_testfix.verify_test_only_fix:96 and regression._collected:67) pass their cfg. Regression test tests/test_regression_testfix.py::test_a_collect_probe_uses_the_callers_cfg_not_the_tree_config proves a tree with committed base_ref=--local no longer crashes the probe.
